_comment: The claim vocabulary (O-03). A banned pattern is a word the product never says about a customer or a named vendor, in the locale it belongs to: no certificate, no approval, no verdict of compliance, no guarantee, no seal, and no third party called unlawful. Every string of customer-facing content is read against the patterns of its locale; a hit fails the build unless the file and path are allowed here, with the reason. The only allowed uses are the disclaimers, which name the claim in order to deny it.

banned.why: a certificate is a verdict nobody here gives
compliance is never stated as a verdict about a customer
behaviour is described and a decision cited; nothing is called unlawful
et certifikat er en dom, ingen her afsiger

adfærd beskrives og en afgørelse citeres; intet kaldes ulovligt

Konformität wird nie als Urteil über einen Kunden ausgesprochen
Verhalten wird beschrieben und eine Entscheidung zitiert; nichts wird rechtswidrig genannt
